config.rationale: Round-1 compact_transformer (hidden=96, depth=4, cls pooling) reached 96.9%. This candidate increases hidden to 128 (divisible by 4 heads, multiple of 8), deepens to 6 layers for more sequential context mixing over the 49 tokens, reduces mlp_ratio to 3 to keep parameter count in check, and switches to mean pooling which is more robust than cls-token pooling when the sequence is short. LR raised to 5e-4 to compensate for the deeper network. Weight decay at 0.03 (AdamW decoupled) provides moderate regularisation. Batch size increased to 128 for more stable gradient estimates with the larger model.
